reviews.comment: Great fan . Easy to install. Not loud at all.  Yes their are cheaper fans but I didn’t want a RGB .
reviews.author: Eric S

reviews.title: Just about perfect for a Ryzen 9700x.
reviews.comment: This cooler does a great job cooling my 9700x CPU, even during gaming.  My last cooler was a Dark Rock Pro 4 for a 10850k system, and it also did great but was bulky.  The Dark Rock 5 (non pro) is a lot less bulky and looks better imho.  Comes with extra clips if you want to add another fan, but I'm not seeing any need for it at this point.  Just be sure your case has good air flow.  The install was simple and straight forward, the included long screw driver is key.
reviews.author: DOUGLAS E JOHNSON

reviews.title: It cools and is very quiet
reviews.comment: Typically I used another brand cooler but wasn't able to find that brand on a recent build. Based on positive reviews, I decided to give this cooler a try. To my surprise, it exceeded my expectations and met all my needs. It even includes a long screwdriver for installation. I was able to achieve the desired cooling temperature, and it operates quietly.
reviews.author: Eric B
